project_type: Windows desktop AI agent — FastAPI/Playwright primary server + PyQt6 native canvas + Eyes vision subsystem + AgentHands keyboard/mouse subsystem
build_system: No build step; pure Python. venv at f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Agent\venv. Install: venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
test_framework: pytest (not yet installed in venv; must be installed first via requirements.txt update). Existing tests live in Hands\tests\ and use unittest.mock. New tests go in tests\ at project root.
verification_instructions: 1. Run: venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt --dry-run to confirm no conflicts. 2. Run: venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\ -v — all smoke tests must pass. 3. Run: venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest Hands\tests\ -v — existing tests must still pass.
environment_constraints: Windows only (win32 platform checks in source). venv\Scripts\python.exe is the interpreter — never use bare 'python'. All file paths use f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Agent\ as root. Never restart any running server. fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, playwright, pydantic are already installed in the venv — pytest and pytest-asyncio are NOT yet installed.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow conventions in existing code: snake_case, type hints, docstrings on public methods, no bare except clauses.
key_patterns: Pydantic v2 BaseModel for request models (from pydantic import BaseModel, field_validator). FastAPI HTTPException for error responses. AsyncMock/MagicMock in tests. httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport(app=app) for endpoint tests (not TestClient, because endpoints are async). eyes._ACTIVE_TASK_SESSION is module-level global. TaskSession in Eyes/eyes.py has task_name, screenshots, is_active — no started_at yet. CURSOR_INJECTION_JS is defined in parallel_canvas.py and imported by parallel_desktop_server.py.
directory_structure: Root: parallel_desktop_server.py (primary FastAPI server, port 8765), parallel_canvas.py (legacy sync canvas), canvas_desktop.py (PyQt6 native canvas), ai_controller.py (native canvas controller), tools.json (script registry), requirements.txt, ARCHITECTURE.md. Eyes/: eyes.py (vision engine), eyes_server.py, eyes_mcp.py, screenshots/. Hands/: agent_hands package, tests/, pyproject.toml. .agents/tasks/: plan files and FEAT artifacts (NOT inside the worktree for git). venv/: Python virtual environment.
